items.headline: Tanzania: Lissu deshdroh se bari, 4 saal jail
items.detail: Tanzania ki High Court ne vipakshi neta Tundu Lissu ko deshdroh ke aarop se bari kar diya, lekin chunav bhadkane ke aarop me chaar saal ki saza sunai; ve appeal karenge.
items.exam_angle: Tanzania me vipakshi neta par faisla — Africa ki rajneeti aur loktantra ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Najib ka house arrest ruka, jail me rahenge
items.detail: Malaysia ke Attorney-General ne poorv PM Najib Razak ke house arrest par asthayi rok lagayi, RM50 million jurmana bharne ke baad bhi; shahi maafi ki vyakhya par sawal uthaye gaye.
items.exam_angle: 1MDB ghotala aur Malaysia ki rajneeti — bhrashtachar aur kanoon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: South Africa me ANC ka sabse kharab natija
items.detail: 81% vote ginne par ANC 31.8% par hai, 2021 se lagbhag 14 point neeche; DA 24.1% par hai aur kai nagar nigam bina spasht bahumat ke hain.
items.exam_angle: South Africa ke sthaniya chunaav — Africa ki sabse badi arthvyavastha ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UN pramukh daud me Grynspan aage
items.detail: Sanyukt Rashtra ke agle mahasachiv ke liye aathve straw poll me Costa Rica ki Rebeca Grynspan ko 15 me se 12 sakaratmak vote mile; Argentina ke Rafael Grossi 9 vote ke saath doosre par rahe, jabki Turkey ke Sinirlioglu chhathe sthan par rahe.
items.exam_angle: Sanyukt Rashtra aur mahasachiv chunav — antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD) / CC BY-SA 2.0

items.headline: Bondi hamle ki 16th peedit ki maut
items.detail: Bondi Beach par December 2025 ke hamle me ghayal 90 saal ki Holocaust survivor Eva Geller ki aspatal me maut ho gayi; hamle me marne walon ki sankhya ab 16 ho gayi hai.
items.exam_angle: Australia me aatankwadi hamla aur samajik suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Judge ne Trump ke arch par rok lagayi
items.detail: Judge Tanya Chutkan ne Trump ke 250-foot wale triumphal arch par 14 din ki rok lagayi, planning panel ki 8-4 se manzoori ke kuch ghante baad; sarkar ka daava hai Congress ne 100 saal pehle manzoori di thi.
items.exam_angle: America me nyaypalika aur karyapalika ke beech takraav — shakti santulan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Russia-Ukraine samjhauta 'bahut kareeb'
items.detail: Trump ne White House me kaha Russia-Ukraine yuddh khatm karne ka samjhauta bahut kareeb hai aur isme pura Europe shamil ho sakta hai; unhone Putin ke doot Kirill Dmitriev se mulaqat ki pushti ki, jabki Abu Dhabi me 10-11 November ko trilateral baatchit tay hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur shanti vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: US carrier Theodore Roosevelt Middle East ki ore
items.detail: Upgrah tasveeron ke mutabik USS Theodore Roosevelt 4 November ko South China Sea me dikha; US adhikariyon ke hawale se November ke ant tak Middle East pahunchne ki ummeed hai, jahan pehle se do carrier maujood hain.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanav: Hormuz se tel supply par asar — Bharat ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump ne Oval Office ko smarak ghoshit kiya
items.detail: Rashtrapati Donald Trump ne Oval Office aur Cabinet Room ko rashtriya smarak ghoshit karne wali ghoshna par hastakshar kiye; midterm chunav me haar ke baad yah unki pehli aadhikarik karravai hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki rajneeti aur rashtrapati ke adhikar — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo ka Latin America daura shuru
items.detail: Feefde ke cancer ki surgery ke teen hafte baad Pope Leo XIV ne Uruguay, Argentina aur Peru ke 12 din ke daure par rawana hue; Vatican ne kaha koi khaas medical intezaam nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Pope ka Latin America daura — dharmik netritva aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Belgium: pravasiyon ke ghar talashi ka kanoon
items.detail: Belgium ki sansad ne kanoon manzoor kiya — jaanch judge ki manzoori se police un pravasiyon ke ghar talashi le sakegi jinki sharan yachika kharij hui aur jo desh chhodne ka aadesh nahi maan rahe; talashi sirf subah 5 se 9 baje ke beech hogi.
items.exam_angle: Europe me pravasan niti aur manavadhikar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nithya Raman LA ki pehli Asian-American mayor
items.detail: Kerala me janmi Nithya Raman ne Los Angeles ke mayor chunav me maujuda mayor Karen Bass ko haraya; Associated Press ne unhe vijeta ghoshit kiya aur Bass ne haar maan li.
items.exam_angle: Bharatiya mool ki neta ka America ke bade sheher me chunav — pravasi Bharatiya aur America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Rubio ne Trump prashasan chhodne ki khabar nakari
items.detail: Bloomberg ki report ke mutabik Rubio midterm haar ke baad prashasan chhodne par vichar kar rahe the; Rubio ne New York Times se kaha Trump ka karyakal pura karna 'hamesha se meri yojana' rahi hai, aur White House ne report ko 'fake news' bataya.
items.exam_angle: America ki rajneeti aur Trump prashasan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Brent $98 paar, tel me tez uchhal
items.detail: Hormuz me tanker hamlo aur Iran tanav ke beech Brent crude 3.88% chadh kar $98.29 prati barrel par band hua; Shukravar subah keemat $99 ke paas pahunchi, jabki UKMTO ke mutabik Ravivar se Khadi me kam se kam paanch jahazon se judi ghatnayein hui hain.
items.exam_angle: Tel ki keemat aur Hormuz — Bharat ki urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gaza me Israeli hamlo me 5 ki maut
items.detail: Guruvar ko Gaza me Israeli hamlo aur golibari me ek mahila aur 12 saal ke ladke sahit paanch log mare gaye; bachav dal ke mutabik yuddhviram ke bawjood hamle jaari hain, jabki Israeli sena ne kaha usne 'aatankwadiyon' ko nishana banaya.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhviram aur manaviya sankat — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: California me 548 ko maut ki saza khatm
items.detail: Governor Gavin Newsom ne California ke death row ke sabhi 548 kaidiyon ki saza ko bina parol ke aajivan karavas me badal diya; yah America ke itihaas ki sabse badi saamuhik maafi hai.
items.exam_angle: America me mrityudand par sabse badi maafi — manavadhikar aur nyay vyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Office of the Lieutenant Governor of California / Public domain

items.headline: France me lakhon ki hadtal, Eiffel Tower band
items.detail: Guruvar ko France bhar me mahangai ke khilaf hadtal aur pradarshan hue; grih mantralaya ke mutabik shaam 5 baje tak lagbhag 6 lakh log sadkon par the, aur Paris me Eiffel Tower aur Arc de Triomphe din bhar band rahe.
items.exam_angle: France me samajik andolan aur shramik hadtal — Europe ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Asia bhar me girawat, Nikkei 6% gira
items.detail: America ki girawat ke baad Asia ke bazaaron me bhi badi girawat aayi; Japan ka Nikkei 6% gira, Taiwan 8% gira aur Hong Kong aur Shanghai bhi gire.
items.exam_angle: Asia ke share bazaar aur AI stock girawat — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Dhillon ne Trump prashasan se istifa diya
items.detail: Bharatiya mool ki Harmeet Kaur Dhillon ne US Justice Department ke Civil Rights Division ke pramukh pad se istifa de diya; ve midterm chunav ke baad prashasan chhodne wali pehli varishth adhikari hain, aur Attorney General Todd Blanche ne 5 November ko unka istifa sweekar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Bharatiya mool ki adhikari aur America ki rajneeti — pravasi Bharatiya aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Google, Meta, TikTok ne California par mukadma kiya
items.detail: Teeno companies ne California ke naye kanoon AB 1709 ko chunauti di jo 16 saal se kam umr ke bachchon ke liye autoplay aur personalised feed par rok lagata hai; kanoon 1 January 2027 se lagu hona hai.
items.exam_angle: Bachchon ki online suraksha aur tech niyam — digital governance ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne Qatar se America ko prastav bheja
items.detail: Iran ne Qatar ke zariye America ko parmanu prastav bheja; Hormuz jaladmarumadhya kholne aur baatchit se pehle saat shartein poori karne ki maang ki, jinme pratibandh hatana aur jami hui sampatti lautana shamil hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz aur parmanu kootneeti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Grenada me Mitchell ki badi jeet, 14 seatein
items.detail: Grenada ke aam chunav me PM Dickon Mitchell ki NDC ne 15 me se 14 seatein jeet kar doosri baar sarkar banayi; lagbhag 61% vote mile aur NNP ke paas sirf ek seat bachi.
items.exam_angle: Caribbean me loktantra aur chunav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canada: 2027 se saalana 3.8 lakh PR
items.detail: Canada ne Budget 2026 ke saath 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan jaari kiya; 2027 se 2029 tak har saal 3,80,000 permanent resident ka lakshya hai, aur 2027 ke ant tak 2,00,000 tak asthayi nivaasiyon ko PR me badalne ka upaay bhi hai.
items.exam_angle: Canada ki aapravaasan neeti — antarrashtriya sambandh aur pravasi Bharatiya ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UNIFIL 31 December ko Lebanon chhodega
items.detail: UNIFIL ne pushti ki ki 31 December 2026 ko uska mandate khatm hote hi vah dakshini Lebanon se hatna shuru kar dega; 1978 se tainat mission ke lagbhag 7,500 shanti sainik tab tak kaam jaari rakhenge.
items.exam_angle: UN shanti mission aur Lebanon — antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.
